mapper.sql: a.apt_id as appointmentId, a.apt_candidate_id as candidateId, a.apt_position_id as positionId, a.apt_stage_id as stageId, coalesce(a.apt_stage_name, psg.psg_name) as stageName, coalesce(a.apt_stage_type, psg.psg_type) as stageType, a.apt_stage_order as stageOrder, a.apt_interviewer_id as interviewerId, a.apt_slot_id as slotId, a.apt_status as status, date_format(a.apt_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as startTime, date_format(a.apt_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as endTime, a.apt_meeting_url as meetingUrl, a.apt_room_id as roomId, u.nick_name as candidateName, t.tal_user_id as candidateUserId, pos.pos_title as positionTitle, pos.pos_company_id as companyId, iu.nick_name as interviewerName, (select max(ses_id) from t_int_session where ses_appointment_id = a.apt_id) as sessionId

from t_sch_appointment a left join t_process_stage psg on psg.psg_id = a.apt_stage_id left join t_tal t on t.tal_id = a.apt_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = a.apt_position_id left join sys_user iu on iu.user_id = a.apt_interviewer_id
mapper.select: select where a.apt_candidate_id = #{candidateId} and a.apt_position_id = #{positionId} and a.apt_status != 2 order by a.apt_start_time, a.apt_id

select s.psg_id as stageId, s.psg_name as stageName, s.psg_type as stageType, s.psg_sort_order as stageOrder from t_process_stage s join t_pos p on p.pos_process_template_id = s.psg_template_id where s.psg_id = #{stageId} and p.pos_id = #{positionId}
select tal_id from t_tal where tal_id = #{candidateId} for update
select user_id from sys_user where user_id = #{interviewerId} and status = '0' for update
select count(*) from t_cmp_binding where bnd_company_id = #{companyId} and bnd_user_id = #{interviewerId} and bnd_status = 1
select count(*) from t_process_instance where pin_candidate_id = #{candidateId} and pin_position_id = #{positionId}
mapper.update: update t_sch_slot set slt_status = #{status}, slt_updated_at = now() where slt_id = #{slotId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_sch_slot (slt_interviewer_id, slt_position_id, slt_start_time, slt_end_time, slt_status) values (#{interviewerId}, #{positionId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, 0)

insert into t_sch_appointment (apt_candidate_id, apt_position_id, apt_stage_id, apt_stage_name, apt_stage_type, apt_stage_order, apt_interviewer_id, apt_slot_id, apt_start_time, apt_end_time, apt_meeting_url, apt_status) values (#{candidateId}, #{positionId}, #{stageId}, #{stageName}, #{stageType}, #{stageOrder}, #{interviewerId}, #{slotId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{meetingUrl}, 0)
mapper.update: update t_sch_appointment set apt_interviewer_id = #{interviewerId}, apt_slot_id = #{slotId}, apt_start_time = #{startTime}, apt_end_time = #{endTime}, apt_status = 0, apt_updated_at = now() where apt_id = #{appointmentId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_msg (msg_receiver_id, msg_sender_id, msg_type, msg_title, msg_content, msg_is_read) values (#{receiverId}, 0, 1, #{title}, #{content}, 0)
